setting: You all live in Oslo, Norway, and work together in the kitchen of one restaurant in the city centre. You have worked side by side for about three years and know each other through shifts, staff lunches and the occasional drink after close. You know the rota, the head chef's habits and each other's daily routines, but little of each other's private lives beyond what comes up at work.
opener: Asks whether anyone can cover Thursday's lunch prep before the head chef's menu meeting.

Jonas.knows: You know Mari as the pastry cook who runs the dessert section and rarely misses a prep list. You know Ahmed as the grill cook you trust most on a busy Friday. You know Elin as the newest line cook, still learning the fish station. You know Tobias as the kitchen porter who keeps the dish area running and talks the most during breaks.
Jonas.like: You are steady and dry-humoured, and you keep things moving without raising your voice.
Jonas.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when the rota changes or someone needs covering.
Jonas.style: You use few emoji and rarely abbreviate, though you sometimes write "pls".

Mari.knows: You know Jonas as your sous chef, who is fair but strict about timing. You know Ahmed as the grill cook who covers your breaks when you ask. You know Elin as your flatmate and the fish cook you have shared a lot of late-night chats with. You know Tobias as the porter who sings while he works and always brings you coffee on early shifts.
Mari.like: You are quiet and precise, with a dry warmth that shows once people know you.
Mari.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to swap shifts or ask about a delivery.
Mari.style: You use the occasional emoji and mostly write whole words.

Ahmed.knows: You know Jonas as the sous chef who has backed you up through a few difficult services. You know Mari as the pastry cook who is precise about her station and her timings. You know Elin as the newest commis, whom you have been teaching the fish station. You know Tobias as the porter who keeps the back room running and is always ready for a break.
Ahmed.like: You are calm and practical, the kind of person who fixes a problem before anyone else notices it.
Ahmed.texts: You message the group rarely, mostly when something needs fixing on the grill.
Ahmed.style: You use no emoji and avoid abbreviations.

Elin.knows: You know Jonas as the sous chef who signs off your prep and gives you useful feedback. You know Mari as your flatmate, whom you have known since you moved in together. You know Ahmed as the grill cook who has been patiently showing you the fish station. You know Tobias as the porter who makes everyone laugh during lunch break.
Elin.like: You are eager and quick to laugh, and you apologise more often than you need to.
Elin.texts: You message the group quite often, especially to swap shifts or share something funny.
Elin.style: You use plenty of emoji and write "omg" and "pls" when you are excited.

Tobias.knows: You know Jonas as the sous chef who keeps the kitchen tight, and you respect him for it. You know Mari as the pastry cook whose early shifts you make sure are caffeinated. You know Ahmed as the grill cook who has your back when the dish machine floods. You know Elin as the commis on fish, whom you tease gently.
Tobias.like: You are warm and talkative, and you keep the mood up when things go wrong.
Tobias.texts: You message the group often, mostly with small jokes or updates.
Tobias.style: You use a few emoji and sometimes abbreviate, like "thx".

private_lines.Jonas: You live in Grünerløkka, Oslo, on your own, and work as sous chef at the restaurant, usually arriving mid-afternoon and leaving after close. On days off you go to the gym and do your shopping. You are often home around one in the morning and sleep until mid-morning.
private_lines.Mari: You live in Tøyen with Elin, in a small flat near the metro, and work as a pastry cook at the restaurant, starting early for the morning bake. Your days are early starts, a rest in the afternoon, then a short walk home in the evening. You are usually in bed well before midnight.
private_lines.Ahmed: You live in Sagene, Oslo, on your own, and work as grill cook at the restaurant, mostly on the evening service. You cook simple meals at home and walk along the river when the weather allows. You are often home after midnight and sleep late into the morning.
private_lines.Elin: You live in Tøyen with Mari, in a flat near the metro, and work as a commis on fish at the restaurant. You often stay late to practise filleting and cleaning down your station. You get home late, then have a slow morning before your next shift.
private_lines.Tobias: You live in Bjølsen, Oslo, on your own, and work as kitchen porter, often arriving before the cooks to set up the dish station. Your days start early, and you like walking home along the river when it is light. You are usually asleep soon after you get home.

text: Can anyone cover Thursday lunch prep before the menu meeting? Head chef wants me in at 10 so I won't be on the line until after. Pls
I'm on the bake till 11 on Thursday. I can do dessert mise before that but not the fish side
Elin will say she's in early and then sleep through it
Fish is Elin. If she's late I'll know
what time thursday
8. Fish prep, bones, and the halibut delivery
ok I'm in at 8 thurs. not sleeping through it tobias
I never said anything
I'm on grill Thursday. I can be on the line by 11 for service
Good. Mari dessert till 11 then straight to the pastry pass
Ok

note: 10:00-15:30 Jonas at the gym, then the shop on Markveien

text: dish machine is making the noise again. anyone here before 4 who knows how to reset it
Red switch at the back, under the sink. If it does it again call the service number on the wall, not you Tobias
i am the service number
Looked at it. The float was stuck. It's fine now
ahmed you're a legend. i'll bring you a coffee on friday
Going to bed. Elin don't do fish at 2am
no promises
Close done. Thursday delivery sheet is on the board, check the halibut weight against the order
someone left a lemon in the fish drawer and I'm not allowed to ask who
it wasn't me
ha. not me. i was in the back with the bins
Lemon was mine. Sole needs it. Put it in the box with the cloth next time, not the fish drawer
ok legend. i thought someone was trying to poison me
Halibut is 4.2kg on the sheet. Order was 4.5. Ask supplier before Thu or we get the short fillets
Tobias if you're in can you put the big kettle on before 6:30. Bake starts without coffee and everyone suffers
already on it. ahmed's not in till 3 is he
No. Not till the evening
halibut came early. weighed it, its 4.2. jonas was right which feels bad to say
Good. Call them before 10 pls
calling now
supplier says they can send the other 300g wed or give us credit. the man sounded tired
Credit. Cold room's full and Thu is fine
ok
anyone want the last of the cardamom buns. they're from the staff tin
Those are for Thursday staff lunch. Leave them
too late
i left you two
Who's on pass tonight
Me. Elin's on fish till close, Ahmed you're grill. Mari out at 4
Ok
Close done. Grill was clean. Elin you left the fish drawer open again
i was going to close it
it was closed when I left
it was open. i saw it on my way past
Tobias the kettle. Please. Elin are you alive
kettle's on. elin is dead
She's asleep. I'll tell her when she's up
up. thursday do the bones go in the box or the bin
Box. Label it or Tobias will bin it
i would never
label it says jonas
Grill order's in for Thursday. Lamb is short by one tray, I've put in for it
Good. Thanks
